title: Apple reaches $5 trillion market capitalization and becomes the most valuable company in the world
summary: The tech giant surpasses the five trillion market value barrier for the first time, ahead of Nvidia and other major companies.

title: Massive sell-off of chip stocks sinks the tech sector and Nasdaq 100 enters technical correction
summary: Fears about the sustainability of investment in artificial intelligence and the economic impact of China cause a widespread collapse in semiconductor stocks.

title: Oil prices fall on expectations of dialogue between the US and Iran and uncertainty over demand
summary: Crude weakens on the possibility of a diplomatic agreement that would increase supply and amid signs of global economic slowdown.

title: SK Hynix reports record earnings driven by AI, while memory stocks show mixed movements
summary: The South Korean semiconductor manufacturer posts a record quarterly profit, although it falls short of market expectations, causing declines in its shares and those of other companies in the sector.

title: Kumamoto earthquake leaves at least 13 dead, thousands of homes without electricity and affects logistics infrastructure
summary: The earthquake disrupts basic services and forces the mobilization of more than 4,600 rescue personnel, while the TSMC plant resumes operations.

title: Grifols increases half-year profit by 28.7% to 227 million euros, driven by immunoglobulin
summary: The Spanish pharmaceutical company benefits from strong demand for its immunoglobulin treatments, offsetting the decline in other revenues.

title: Wall Street cautiously awaits the Federal Reserve's decision and big tech earnings
summary: Futures for the major indices trade lower as investors anticipate the Fed meeting and earnings from Apple, Microsoft and other megacaps.

title: Japan's government considers a temporary cut to the consumption tax on food
summary: The national council includes a reduced rate of 1% in the proposal to be submitted to Prime Minister Takaichi.

title: Japanese stock market opens lower dragged down by weakness in the tech sector
summary: The Nikkei index falls in early trading due to doubts about the outlook for artificial intelligence.

title: Chinese stocks start the session higher on expectations of economic stimulus
summary: The Shanghai market rises driven by hopes of new fiscal and monetary policy measures.

title: Hong Kong market extends its winning streak ahead of key China policy meetings
summary: The Hang Seng continues its positive trend on expectations that upcoming meetings will announce support measures.
